respStmt.resp: Processed the text data from Muni Deepratnasagar Ji's DOCX files into romanized TEI.

sourceDesc.p: This electronic text is based on the DOCX files of the entire Śvētāmbara canon provided by Muni Deepratnasagar and made available through Jain e-Library. The ID of the DOCX file for this text is 003701. The source of Muni Deepratnasagar's edition, in turn, is the “Āgama Mañjūṣā” series (ID 003251).

encodingDesc.p: The Ācārāṅgasūtra is divided into two books (śrutaskandhas or suyakkhandhas). Scholars since Jacobi, or rather since Śīlāṅka, have regarded the first book as older than the second. The first book is divided into chapters (ajjhayaṇas), and these chapters are divided into lessons (uddēsas). Sections are numbered continuously from the beginning of the text.

The second book is divided into appendices (cūlās), and these, in turn, are divided into chapters (ajjhayaṇas), which are numbered continuously from the beginning of the second book. Starting from the second appendix, each chapter (ajjhayaṇa) is also called a sattikkaya, which are then numbered continuously from the beginning of the second chapter. Sections in the second book, like the first, are numbered continously from the beginning of the text.

p.s: suyaṁ mē āusaṁ! tēṇaṁ bhagavayā ēvamakkhāyaṁ ihamēgēsiṁ nō saṇṇā bhavaï.

taṁ jahā — puratthimāō vā disāō āgaō ahamaṁsi, dāhiṇāō vā disāō āgaō ahamaṁsi, paccatthimāō vā disāō āgaō ahamaṁsi, uttarāō vā disāō āgaō ahamaṁsi, uḍḍhāō vā disāō āgaō ahamaṁsi , ahē vā disāō āgaō ahamaṁsi, annayarīō vā disāō anudisāō vā āgaō ahamaṁsi, ēvamēgēsiṁ nō nātaṁ bhavati.
